race.comment: COCO AFFAIR (8) comes here with race fitness on her side after attacking the line first-up with a respectable third over 1100m at Warwick Farm. Will relish the extra trip from the inside gate with Zac Lloyd staying aboard. Sure to go close. WENDELL (2) gelded over the break and has a host of gear changes first-up. Travelled well on debut but failed to let down with a fading tenth over 1000m at the Gold Coast last January. Found to be lame in near hind leg on that occasion. Trialled well and will need some luck from the draw. Each way. DON VALIENTE (3) had mixed luck in his first prep and gelded over the break. Respect. GRAND SADDLES (10) is another likely improver that deserves a market watch.
